neighbours.label: the token ' tie' and its forms (tying, tied, ties, necktie)
fire: Before the interview he spent ten minutes trying to tie a proper Windsor knot.
My grandfather taught me the trick of tying a bowline with one hand.

She bought him a silk necktie with small blue anchors on it.

Rescuers found the climbers tied to the anchor bolts, waiting out the storm.

Please remember to tie your shoelaces before you go down the stairs.
